personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium fractional real estate platform with 3D glass depth, deep slate surfaces, and antique gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cards must not be cramped. Allow 16-24pt between major sections. Forms and lists should breathe.

do's: Use heavily for sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use for bottom tab bar and floating action buttons.
Use translucent cards with border 0.5pt to simulate a glass edge over background images.
dont's: Do not blur form fields or body text regions.
Avoid stacking more than 2 blurred surfaces.
Ensure foreground text on glass is fully readable (use tinted underlays if necessary).

screens.name: Auth / Role Selector
screens.purpose: Splash screen that transitions into login/signup and role selection (Investor, Company, Admin).

states.loading: Gold spinner centered over glass background.

screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract 3D finance background image with a dark gradient scrim (top to bottom). Massive, luxurious glass cards stacked vertically for role selection. Brand title in large Fraunces serif.

screens.name: Investor Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing portfolio snapshot, wallet balance, and featured properties to invest in.

states.empty: Illustration of a vault/building with 'Start building your portfolio' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Hero section is a premium glass card showing Total Portfolio Value and Monthly Returns over a subtle gold-tinted noise background. Below, a horizontally scrolling list of 'Featured Properties' (real photos, vertical gradient scrim, text at bottom). Quick action buttons (Deposit, Withdraw) in a 2-col grid.

screens.name: Property Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific property, its financials, and the 'Buy Shares' action.
screens.layout: Parallax hero image of the property filling the top 40% of the screen with a gradient scrim. Content below slides up over the image. Key stats (Valuation, Share Price, ROI) in a 3-col grid of translucent cards. Sticky fixed bottom container (glass or solid surface) with 'Buy Shares' primary gold CTA.

screens.name: Buy Shares Modal
screens.purpose: Transaction flow for purchasing fractional shares.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet modal using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Shows property thumbnail, a sleek slider or +/- quantity selector for shares. Auto-calculates total cost vs Wallet balance. Large confirmation button.

screens.name: Portfolio
screens.purpose: Detailed view of investor's holdings and performance.

states.empty: Glass card saying 'No shares owned yet.'

screens.layout: List layout. Header is a dark abstract gold background with overall performance graph/metrics. Holdings are listed as rich rows: property thumbnail (left), title + shares owned (center), current value + P/L in emerald (right).

screens.name: Wallet
screens.purpose: Manage deposits, withdrawals, and view transaction history.
screens.layout: Large hero balance at the top. 'Deposit' (primary gold) and 'Withdraw' (secondary) buttons side-by-side. Transaction history as a clean list below, segmented by date. Use 'success' color for deposits, 'surfaceTertiary' icon containers for others.

screens.name: Marketplace
screens.layout: Glass segmented control at the top (Buy / Sell). List of active orders. Each order is a glass card showing the property, asking price per share, and 'Accept Order' button.

screens.name: Company Dashboard
screens.purpose: Dashboard for real estate companies to manage listings.
screens.layout: KPI metrics at the top (Total Raised, Active Properties). List of properties managed by the company. Floating Action Button (FAB) in gold to 'Add Property'.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Super admin view for platform oversight and approvals.
screens.layout: Dense but luxurious layout. Top section: Platform TVL, Total Users. Tabbed sections below for 'KYC Approvals', 'Property Approvals', and 'Interest Distribution'. List items have 'Approve' / 'Reject' (success/error) ghost buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality. Do NOT use pure black backgrounds; stick to the slate hexes (#121215, #1C1C21) to allow glass surfaces to show depth.
Implement the 'NO BLUES' policy globally. Use Emerald (#2A9D8F) for success/positive values, and Deep Ruby (#C1121F) for errors/negative values. Primary brand is Antique Gold (#D4AF37).

Whenever displaying property images (especially hero or list headers), ALWAYS apply the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure white text overlay is legible.
Use 'Fraunces' for major display numbers (like Portfolio Balance, Share Price) and Titles to give it a cinematic, expensive editorial feel. Use 'Satoshi' for body text and labels.
The app requires three distinct role views (Investor, Company, Admin). Start with a Splash/Auth screen that lets the user explicitly select their role, which dictates the layout of the Bottom Tabs.
Emphasize the '3D-like' request by using translucent `surfaceSecondary` cards with an ultra-thin 0.5pt `border` over image backgrounds, effectively creating a frosted glass edge effect.

Ensure the primary CTA ('Buy Shares', 'Deposit', etc.) remains sticky at the bottom of the screen (above safe area) using a fixed container with a subtle glass or fade backdrop to prevent scroll content collision.
